results.title: TikTok Statistics for Marketers in 2026 - Shopify
results.content:
TikTok has high adoption among Gen Z and younger, but other demographics are also increasingly using the platform.

The majority of TikTok users are 18 and older, which is important to note because these are the TikTok users brands can advertise to (the minimum user age is 13, but TikTok ads can only be shown to users over 18).

But how does the user age breakdown look among those over 18? TikTok users over 18 fell into the following age brackets. [...] ### How fast is TikTok growing?

TikTok is growing quickly, reaching one billion worldwide users faster than other apps. The popular social media platform is forecasted to reach approximately 1.9 billion users by 2029.

### What is the age demographic of TikTok?

The largest demographic among TikTok users is between 25 and 34 (41.6% of TikTok users over 18). TikTok’s users skew younger than other social media platforms, but that is changing as older users join the app. [...] While it’s clear Gen Z users dominate the platform, there is increasing usage among older generations. Over the course of a year, usage rose from 7.9% to 9.2% for 45- to 54-year-olds and 6.2% to 8.4% for those 55 and older. This could be a signal that brands with older target audiences should consider the platform when developing their TikTok marketing strategies.
